faq.question: Q1. What is RARI Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Regional Ayurveda Research Institute (RARI) has released advertisement number 10/2026-27 to fill 2 vacancies for Project Associate-I (Chemistry) and Project Associate-I (IT) posts on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under RARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate-I posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application for RARI Project Associate?
faq.answer: The last date to submit CV and supporting documents via email is 17 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 21 October 2026 at 10:00 AM (IST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Associate-I (Chemistry)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Concerned subject from a recognized university/Institution.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Project Associate-I (IT)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university/Institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for RARI Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 35 years as on the date of interview, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for RARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RARI Project Associate-I (Chemistry)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for those who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET or GATE, and Rs. 25,000/- + 20% HRA for others who do not fulfill the above.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted in Hybrid Mode, either offline at CCRAS - Regional Ayurveda Research Institute (RARI), Bantalab, Jammu, or online via Google Meet.
